entries.name: Dartmouth College Universal Need-Blind Financial Aid for International Students
entries.fields: any
covers: books and personal expenses (full-tuition scholarship without loans for family income under USD 125,000; zero parent contribution under USD 65,000)
entries.eligibility: Admitted undergraduates of any citizenship; need-blind admission for all international applicants since the Class of 2026 and 100% of demonstrated need met. Aid is need-based only.
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodian students apply directly through the Common Application and submit the CSS Profile and income documents; no nomination or embassy step.
entries.deadline_note: Applications open in August; Early Decision deadline 1 November, Regular Decision deadline early January each year.
entries.language_req: English; TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo recommended for non-native speakers

entries.name: Bowdoin College Need-Blind Admission and Full-Need Aid for International Students
entries.fields: any (liberal arts)
covers: books and personal expenses (grants only, no loans)
entries.eligibility: First-year applicants of any citizenship; need-blind admission and 100% of calculated need met without loans. Not available to international transfer students.
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodian applicants apply directly via the Common Application and file the CSS Profile; family ability to pay is not considered in admission.
entries.deadline_note: Applications open in August; Early Decision I deadline 15 November, Early Decision II and Regular Decision deadline early January each year.
entries.language_req: English; TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo recommended for non-native speakers

entries.name: Brown University Need-Blind Financial Aid for International Undergraduates
entries.fields: any
covers: books and personal expenses (100% of demonstrated need met, no loans)
entries.eligibility: First-year international applicants (need-blind from the Class of 2029, entering fall 2025, onward); aid is need-based and meets 100% of demonstrated need for all admitted students.
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodian students apply directly via the Common Application and submit the CSS Profile with parental income documents; no nomination required.
entries.deadline_note: Applications open in August; Early Decision deadline 1 November, Regular Decision deadline early January each year.
entries.language_req: English; TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo recommended for non-native speakers

entries.name: APU Tuition Reduction Scholarship for International Students
entries.provider: Ritsumeikan Asia Pacific University (with MEXT and corporate/individual donors)
entries.fields: any APU program (Asia Pacific Studies, International Management, Sustainability and Tourism; graduate programs)
covers: tuition reduction of 30%, 50%, 65%, 80% or 100% for the standard period until graduation
entries.eligibility: International applicants who will hold a Japanese 'Student' residence status before enrolling; assessed on financial need, application documents, online assessment and recorded video interview. Applying earlier in each enrollment period improves chances.
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodian nationals apply directly through the APU online application and tick the scholarship request in the same application; no embassy or ministry step. APU has a large Southeast Asian student body.
entries.deadline_note: Several application periods each year for April and September enrollment (2027 enrollment applications running through 2026-27); scholarship is requested at the time of the admission application and early applicants have a greater chance.
entries.language_req: English-basis: TOEFL iBT/IELTS or equivalent; Japanese-basis: JLPT N2 or higher

entries.name: KAIST International Undergraduate Scholarship (KAIST Scholarship)
entries.provider: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST)
entries.fields: STEM (all KAIST undergraduate majors; non-declared major system in first year)
covers: full tuition for up to 8 semesters
entries.eligibility: International high-school graduates (or expected graduates) who are not Korean citizens and hold no Korean dual citizenship; strong mathematics and science record; scholarship selected during admission review when 'KAIST Scholarship' is ticked on the Statement of Financial Resources.
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodian students apply online directly to KAIST (apply.kaist.ac.kr) for the Fall intake only; no government nomination. Scholarship results are announced with admission results.
entries.deadline_note: Fall 2027 intake: Early Admissions closes 22 October 2026 (recommendations by 29 October); Regular Admissions opens 10 November 2026 and closes 14 January 2027 (recommendations by 21 January 2027).
entries.language_req: English proficiency (TOEFL/IELTS/TOEIC etc.) recommended; instruction in English

entries.name: Yonsei University Underwood International College (UIC) Admissions Scholarship
entries.fields: any UIC major (humanities, social sciences, sciences, engineering, techno-art; taught in English)
covers: full tuition for 4 years (admissions scholarship); need-based full, half or one-third tuition awards for enrolled students
entries.eligibility: Newly admitted international students at UIC are automatically considered; selection based on admission evaluation. Need-based and merit-based awards continue for enrolled students based on GPA and financial circumstances.
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodian nationals apply through the Yonsei international admissions portal for UIC; scholarship consideration is automatic with the admission application.
entries.deadline_note: Two international admission rounds each year: applications for Spring entry close around September-October and for Fall entry around March-May; check UIC admissions page for exact dates.
entries.language_req: English (TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo or English-medium schooling)

entries.name: Korea University International Admission Scholarships (Global Leader Scholarship A/B)
entries.provider: Korea University, Office of International Affairs
entries.fields: any Korea University undergraduate major
covers: partial to full tuition waiver based on admission evaluation
entries.eligibility: International undergraduate applicants (both parents non-Korean) admitted through the international admission track; scholarships are awarded from the application documents, no separate application. Results announced with admission results.
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodian nationals apply online via the Korea University OIA international admission portal; no nomination required.
entries.deadline_note: Freshman admissions for Fall intake usually accept applications around February-April and for Spring intake around September-October; see the current Application Guide.
entries.language_req: English (TOEFL/IELTS) or Korean (TOPIK) depending on program

entries.name: SMU ASEAN Undergraduate Scholarship
entries.fields: any SMU undergraduate degree (business, economics, accountancy, law, computing, social sciences)
covers: 100% of subsidised tuition fees after MOE Tuition Grant
entries.eligibility: Citizens of ASEAN member countries excluding Singapore (Cambodia is explicitly listed); awarded on merit; recipients must accept the MOE Tuition Grant with 3-year work bond in Singapore; cannot hold other scholarships concurrently without approval.
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodia is named among eligible countries; Cambodian applicants apply for SMU admission online and are considered for the scholarship on the strength of their application.
entries.deadline_note: SMU international applications typically open in October and close around February-March for the August intake.
entries.language_req: English (IELTS/TOEFL or English-medium qualification)

entries.name: HKU Entrance Scholarships for International Students
entries.fields: any HKU full-time undergraduate program
covers: accommodation and general living allowance (top awards)
entries.eligibility: Outstanding non-local applicants with international qualifications (IB, A-levels, SAT/AP, national exams) admitted to full-time undergraduate degrees; merit-based; automatically considered on submission of the admission application, no separate scholarship application.
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodian students apply directly through HKU's online international admissions; scholarship results are announced with the admission offer.
entries.deadline_note: International applications open in September; main round deadline typically in early-mid January for September entry, with later rounds accepted until the summer.
entries.language_req: English (IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL iBT 93 or equivalent)

entries.name: HKUST Academic Admissions Scholarships and Global Learners Scholarship
entries.provider: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
entries.fields: any HKUST undergraduate program
covers: up to HKD 60,000 allowance per year (top awards), renewable
entries.eligibility: All undergraduate applicants with international qualifications are automatically considered on academic merit and non-academic achievements; the Global Learners Scholarship targets applicants from underrepresented nationalities. No separate application.
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodian applicants apply online through HKUST Undergraduate Admissions; as an underrepresented nationality they are automatically considered for the Global Learners Scholarship as well as academic scholarships.
entries.deadline_note: Applications open in September; early round deadline around mid-November and main round around early January for September entry.
entries.language_req: English (IELTS 6.0-6.5 / TOEFL iBT 80 or equivalent)

entries.name: CUHK Admission Scholarships for International Students
entries.provider: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
entries.fields: any CUHK full-time undergraduate program
covers: allowance up to HKD 66,000 per year (selected awards), renewable
one-off awards HKD 50,000-214,000 for non-academic excellence
entries.eligibility: Local and non-local new undergraduates with excellent academic or non-academic performance; no application needed, CUHK identifies qualified admitted students automatically.
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodian students apply through CUHK international undergraduate admissions online and are automatically considered for admission scholarships.
entries.deadline_note: International applications open in September/October; early round deadline typically early January, with later rounds through the spring for September entry.
entries.language_req: English (IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL iBT 80 or equivalent)

entries.name: Mahidol Postgraduate Scholarships for International Students
entries.provider: Mahidol University, Faculty of Graduate Studies
entries.fields: any master's or doctoral program at Mahidol (some medical programs excluded)
covers: additional expenses/allowance as specified in the annual announcement
entries.eligibility: International students eligible for enrollment in a Mahidol master's or doctoral program in the relevant academic year; selection by academic merit; must meet program English requirements.
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodian students apply for admission to a Mahidol graduate program and submit the scholarship application through the Faculty of Graduate Studies; Cambodian nationals are also specifically eligible for the CMB Foundation Mekong Region postgraduate scholarship at Mahidol.
entries.deadline_note: Announced annually (2026 round published for academic year 2026); applications typically accepted in the first half of the year for August entry.
entries.language_req: English (TOEFL/IELTS or MU-ELT per program)

entries.name: CMB Foundation Mahidol Postgraduate Scholarship for Mekong Region Scholars
entries.provider: China Medical Board (CMB) Foundation and Mahidol University
entries.fields: postgraduate programs at Mahidol University (health and related fields)
entries.eligibility: Nationals of Cambodia, Lao PDR, Myanmar and Vietnam admitted to a Mahidol postgraduate program; academic merit and commitment to return to contribute in home country.
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodia is explicitly named as an eligible country; apply for admission to Mahidol and then for the CMB Mekong Region scholarship through the Faculty of Graduate Studies.
entries.deadline_note: Announced through the Faculty of Graduate Studies each year; typically applications in the first half of the year for August entry.
entries.language_req: English (TOEFL/IELTS or MU-ELT per program)

entries.name: Asian University for Women Need-Based Scholarships
entries.fields: liberal arts and sciences (undergraduate; plus pre-undergraduate Pathways/Access programs)
covers: international travel (full scholarship); partial scholarships also offered
entries.eligibility: Women from Asia (primarily South, Southeast, West Asia and Middle East) who have completed 10+2 secondary education with roughly 60% average including English and mathematics; need-blind admission; demonstrated leadership and commitment to social change; aid based on demonstrated financial need.
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodian women apply online directly to AUW; Cambodia is within the Southeast Asia recruitment region and AUW has enrolled Cambodian students. Scholarship application is part of the admission process.
entries.deadline_note: Applications for the following academic year generally open around October-November and close around March-May; rolling review.
entries.language_req: English (minimum 60% in English exam; AUW's own assessment; no IELTS required)

entries.name: KAUST Fellowship
entries.provider: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)
entries.fields: STEM (17 disciplines across engineering, physical, biological, computer and environmental sciences)
entries.eligibility: Bachelor's degree (for MS) or relevant master's (for PhD) in a STEM field with strong GPA; GRE optional; English proficiency (TOEFL iBT 79 / IELTS 6.5) unless exempt; all admitted students automatically receive the fellowship (no separate application).
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodian nationals apply directly through the KAUST online application; no nomination or embassy process; the fellowship is automatic on admission.
entries.deadline_note: Applications for 2027 entry open mid-August 2026; Spring 2027 (PhD only) and Fall 2027 (MS, MS/PhD, PhD) deadlines are published on the admission timeline (Fall deadlines usually fall between January and March).
entries.language_req: TOEFL iBT 79 or IELTS 6.5 (waived for graduates of English-medium universities in listed countries)

entries.name: Lester B. Pearson International Student Scholarship
entries.fields: any U of T undergraduate program
covers: full residence support for four years
entries.eligibility: International students (non-Canadian, requiring a study permit) in their final year of secondary school or graduated no earlier than June 2026; must be nominated by their school; must begin U of T studies in September 2027; about 37 awards per year based on academic excellence, creativity and leadership.
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodian students must be nominated by their Cambodian (or international) secondary school, which registers with U of T; then apply for admission and complete the Pearson application. No embassy process.
entries.deadline_note: Nomination portal opens 6 July 2026; school nomination deadline 9 October 2026; U of T admission application deadline 16 October 2026; Pearson scholarship application deadline 6 November 2026.
entries.language_req: English (IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL iBT 100 or U of T-recognised English-medium schooling)

entries.name: Bocconi4Access to Education Need-Based Scholarships and Tuition Waivers for International Students
entries.fields: economics, management, finance, data science, political science, law
covers: full or partial tuition waiver based on family economic need
some awards include accommodation and a living allowance (Bocconi Scholarship for International Students)
entries.eligibility: International candidates admitted to the first year of a Bachelor/Law or Master of Science program for a.y. 2027-28 who submit the Bocconi4Access to Education application with family income and asset documentation; merit is assessed from the admission application.
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodian applicants apply online for Bocconi admission and submit the Bocconi4Access application in the same portal; no embassy involvement.
entries.deadline_note: Bachelor: early session applications close in the autumn and further sessions run until early spring 2027, with the funding request submitted alongside the admission application; Master: four selection rounds between September 2026 and April 2027, most scholarships allocated in earlier rounds.
entries.language_req: English (IELTS/TOEFL/Cambridge; SAT/ACT or Bocconi test for bachelor)

entries.name: University of Bologna International Talents Scholarship and Unibo Action 2 Study Grants
entries.provider: Alma Mater Studiorum - Università di Bologna
entries.fields: any (calls specify eligible degree programmes; International Talents targets second-cycle master's)
covers: study grant (EUR 6,500 per year for 2 years for International Talents; EUR 11,000 gross under Unibo Action 2)
entries.eligibility: International students (admission qualification obtained outside the Italian system) matriculating in an eligible Bologna degree programme; merit-based on admission test scores or academic record; must not already hold an Italian degree.
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodian students apply through the annual call on bandi.unibo.it while applying for admission; no embassy step. Contact internationaldesk@unibo.it for the current call.
entries.deadline_note: Calls are usually published around January-February with deadlines around March-May for enrolment the following September.
entries.language_req: English B2 (IELTS 6.0 or equivalent) for English-taught programmes; Italian B2 for Italian-taught programmes

entries.name: ANU Chancellor's International Scholarship
entries.fields: any ANU undergraduate or postgraduate coursework program
covers: 25% or 50% tuition fee reduction for the duration of the program
entries.eligibility: International students applying for admission to ANU; automatically assessed across 9 citizenship-based categories (at least one open to students from anywhere in the world); awarded on academic merit; no separate application.
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodian applicants apply online for ANU admission and are automatically assessed for the highest-value category they are eligible for.
entries.deadline_note: Automatic with admission; ANU accepts international applications year-round for February and July intakes (apply several months before the intake).
entries.language_req: English (IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL iBT 80 or equivalent)

entries.name: Melbourne Research Scholarship (Graduate Research Scholarships)
entries.fields: any graduate research (Masters by Research or PhD)
covers: full tuition fee offset (2 years MRes / 4 years PhD)
living allowance AUD 39,500 per year (2026 rate)
relocation grant AUD 3,000 for overseas students
entries.eligibility: International applicants to a Masters by Research or doctoral degree with excellent academic results and research potential; automatically considered when applying for admission; over 300 awards per year to international candidates.
entries.cambodia_note: Cambodian applicants submit a graduate research application online (with supervisor agreement) and are automatically considered; no separate scholarship form.
entries.deadline_note: Applications accepted year-round; international candidates should apply by 31 October for the following year's main scholarship round (later rounds in the first half of the year).
entries.language_req: English (IELTS 6.5 with no band below 6.0 or TOEFL iBT 79, program-dependent)
